jobs.title: Director, Analytics & Insights
jobs.description:
Department:
Technology

Location:
Toronto, ON

Compensation:
CA$130,000 - CA$170,000 / year

Description

What we do every day to be our very best

Every day at Securian Canada means a day spent helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. We’re agile and innovative, and we aren't afraid to challenge and create, or bring diverse perspectives to our work.

Who We Need

As our Director, Analytics & Insights
, you'll help shape how data drives decisions across Securian Canada.

We're looking for a leader who sees beyond dashboards and reports. Someone who is energized by complex business challenges, naturally curious about what drives performance, and passionate about transforming data into meaningful business outcomes. You'll play a pivotal role in building and evolving an enterprise analytics capability
that empowers leaders with trusted insights, scalable analytics products, modern business intelligence, and practical AI-enabled solutions
.

Reporting to the AVP, Data Solutions, you'll lead a multidisciplinary team
responsible for Analytics & Insights, Business Intelligence, and Analytics Engineering. Working across business and technology teams, you'll help create a shared understanding of customers, products, markets, financial performance, and organizational priorities, enabling smarter decisions at every level of the organization.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on leadership
. You'll influence enterprise priorities
, guide complex analytical initiatives, challenge assumptions, and help leaders translate insights into action.

The leader we're looking for combines strong business judgment with technical depth
. You start with the decision that needs to be made, not the tool that will be used. You understand that data and analytics are strategic business assets
and know how to balance immediate business needs with scalable enterprise solutions. You're pragmatic, collaborative, governance-minded, and skilled at translating complex analytical concepts into compelling business narratives that drive action.

Most importantly, you're passionate about building high-performing teams
, developing talent
, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment where people can do their best work while making a meaningful impact
.

At Securian Canada, analytics is about more than understanding what happened. It's about helping people make better decisions that support our mission of helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. You'll join a team of talented professionals who are committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and creating solutions that make a real difference across our business.

The base salary range for this position is between $130,000 to $170,000 depending on experience. Details of our additional benefits are outlined below. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Only one position is available. However, it may be based in multiple locations: Toronto (ON), or Waterloo (ON), or Montreal (QC).

What You Will Do

Lead Enterprise Analytics Strategy & Decision Support

Define and execute an analytics and insights roadmap aligned with enterprise, market, customer, and partner priorities.
Transform strategic business questions into actionable analytical opportunities, KPI frameworks, data requirements, and decision-support solutions.
Deliver meaningful insights into business performance, customer behaviour, claims experience, product results, portfolio trends, operational effectiveness, and emerging risks.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives that drive informed decision-making.
Establish scalable practices that improve prioritization, delivery, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.

Build Modern Analytics Products & Business Intelligence Capabilities

Lead the evolution from fragmented reporting toward trusted, enterprise-scale analytics products.
Oversee the development of curated datasets, semantic models, certified metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and client-facing reporting solutions.
Partner with Data Pipeline Engineering, Technology, Governance, Finance, and business leaders to strengthen analytics foundations and support critical business priorities.
Improve self-service analytics capabilities while reducing manual effort, duplicated logic, and disconnected solutions.
Ensure analytics products are scalable, reliable, understandable, and centered around real business decisions.

Advance AI, Machine Learning & Analytical Innovation

Identify practical opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, and AI can create measurable business value.
Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, data readiness, adoption potential, and long-term sustainability.
Establish governance, controls, explainability, data quality standards, and operating requirements needed to support responsible AI and advanced analytics.
Guide innovative solutions from ideation through implementation, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and long-term success.

Develop High-Performing Teams & Analytics Capabilities

Lead, coach, and inspire a team of professionals across analytics, insights, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics engineering.
Foster a culture focused on analytical excellence, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and business partnership.
Provide guidance on analytical problem solving, data-product design, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
Help team members grow beyond traditional reporting by strengthening skills in problem framing, root-cause analysis, insight generation, and strategic recommendations.
Create an environment where innovation, curiosity, and measurable business outcomes are valued and celebrated.

Build Strong Partnerships Across the Organization

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping connect business priorities to data-driven solutions.
Build strong relationships across Data Solutions, Technology, Finance, Operations, and business teams.
Influence decision-making by bringing clarity, insight, and strategic perspective to complex challenges.
Champion a data-informed culture that increases confidence, consistency, and trust in organizational decision-making.

What You Will Bring

University degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data science, decision support, or related fields, including leadership responsibilities.
Demonstrated success building, transforming, or significantly advancing enterprise analytics capabilities within a complex organization.
Strong experience translating ambiguous business challenges into actionable analytical solutions, meaningful insights, and measurable outcomes.
Deep expertise in SQL, Python, analytical data modeling, business intelligence platforms, and modern cloud data environments.
Experience developing scalable analytical datasets, curated data products, KPI frameworks, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions.
Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, from source systems and data engineering through analytics delivery and business consumption.
Experience applying advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, or AI-enabled solutions to business challenges.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders while effectively leading highly technical teams.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience building, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.
Experience within insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is considered an asset.
Experience with cloud data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, and modern self-service BI platforms.
Knowledge of responsible AI practices, model governance, data quality, lineage, explainability, and operational controls.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and inspire action through data.
A strategic and product-oriented mindset focused on delivering sustainable, scalable solutions that create long-term business value.

Why join?

When you’re a part of Securian Canada, you’re a member of an agile and innovative, high-performing, bright-thinking, make-things-happen culture – so that together, we can discover the art of possible.

At our company, we see your potential on day one and challenge you to grow your unique strengths as you create a career filled with opportunity, collaboration, and purpose.

You’ll also be part of a team that’s committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and who values diverse perspectives, so that you can be the person you want to be – both in, and outside, work.

Securian Canada offers a competitive total rewards program with a variety of perks and benefits, including:

Flexible work arrangements with monthly financial allocations to support your work-life balance;
Generous starting paid vacation time, plus additional vacation days for every year of service;
Paid volunteer day so you can dedicate time to a cause you are passionate about;
Paid personal and wellness days to support your total wellbeing;
Educational assistance of up to $3,500 a year (with approval from your manager);
Flexible health and wellness account (in addition to comprehensive drug and dental coverage) to help pay for a wide range of wellbeing services that are meaningful to you;
Up to 14% of combined contributions to the RRSP matching program;
Family-friendly maternity/parental leave and,
Many more benefits, perks and programs.

If you have at least 70% of the qualifications we're looking for, want to work in a fast-growing, leading and progressive company, and feel driven to help Canadians and their families build secure futures – we want to hear from you!

Take the first step in building your future with Securian Canada. Apply now.

jobs.title: Chef(fe) de l’analyse marketing / Head of Marketing Analytics
jobs.description:
Brief Description

Qui est Manmade?

Nous sommes un détaillant en ligne de produits essentiels de première qualité basé à Montréal, connu particulièrement jusqu'à présent pour nos boxer pour hommes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide depuis notre lancement en 2021, et la marque est véritablement à un tournant pour devenir un nom familier au Canada, et elle se développe déjà en parallèle sur le marché américain.

Qui recherchons-nous?

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de l’analytique marketing
pour bâtir et diriger la fonction d’analytique marketing de Manmade.

Vous serez responsable de la façon dont nous mesurons et interprétons la performance marketing, en regroupant les données de nos différents canaux pour offrir une vision claire et fiable des facteurs qui contribuent aux résultats de l’entreprise. Une priorité sera de créer une source de référence unique et centralisée
pour la performance marketing et de mettre en place les tableaux de bord, les indicateurs clés de performance et les cadres de mesure qui guideront les décisions de nos équipes.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior avec une forte implication opérationnelle
. Vous devrez explorer les données, créer des tableaux de bord, analyser la performance et résoudre vous-même les problèmes, tout en établissant les bases d’une équipe et d’une fonction capables d’évoluer avec Manmade.

Si vous aimez transformer des données complexes en décisions d’affaires claires et souhaitez bâtir une fonction à partir de zéro, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?

Nous nous développons rapidement, les choses changent vite et une présence en interne est nécessaire.

Ce que nous offrons?
Nous pensons qu'un travail de qualité commence par un environnement de qualité. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous bénéficierez de déjeuners quotidiens gratuits, de collations et de boissons pour vous permettre de rester en forme et concentré. Nous offrons une assurance de groupe payée à 100 %, des salaires compétitifs qui sont révisés régulièrement avec des augmentations annuelles garanties, et une structure de primes de partage des bénéfices pour que tout le monde participe à notre succès.

Nous sommes dans une phase de croissance, ce qui signifie de réelles opportunités pour vous d'apprendre, de vous développer et de faire passer votre carrière au niveau supérieur. Avant tout, vous ferez partie d'une culture amusante, innovante et respectueuse où vos idées sont valorisées et où votre impact est réel.

Responsabilités

Bâtir et prendre en charge la fonction d’analytique et de mesure marketing de Manmade, tant pour l’acquisition que pour la fidélisation de la clientèle.
Créer une source de référence unique pour la performance marketing en regroupant les données de Meta, Google, TikTok, du marketing par courriel, du marketing d’influence, de Shopify et de l’analytique Web.
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance et des rapports offrant aux équipes Marketing et à la direction une vision claire de la performance.
Analyser les indicateurs clés, notamment le coût d’acquisition client (CAC), la valeur vie client (LTV), le rendement des dépenses publicitaires (ROAS), le ratio d’efficacité marketing (MER), la rétention, la conversion, les cohortes de clients et la performance des canaux.
Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing et Finance pour relier les investissements et la performance marketing aux revenus, à la rentabilité par client et à une croissance rentable.
Évaluer la performance des canaux, des campagnes, des audiences et des créations publicitaires, puis traduire les résultats en recommandations claires et concrètes.
Développer l’approche de Manmade en matière d’attribution, d’incrémentalité, d’expérimentation et de mesure marketing, notamment au moyen de tests A/B, de tests géographiques et de groupes témoins.
Consolider et valider les données provenant des différentes plateformes afin de garantir l’exactitude et la fiabilité des rapports.
Mener des analyses approfondies pour répondre à des questions d’affaires complexes et repérer des occasions d’amélioration en matière d’acquisition, de fidélisation et de valeur vie client.
Mettre en place des processus, des outils et une infrastructure analytiques capables de soutenir la croissance, et définir la feuille de route de la fonction.
Maintenir une forte implication opérationnelle tout en bâtissant et en dirigeant, à terme, une équipe d’analytique marketing performante.

Éxigences

De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience progressive en analytique marketing, en analytique de croissance, en intelligence d’affaires, en analyse de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
Solide expérience en commerce électronique, en vente directe aux consommateurs (DTC), dans le secteur des produits de consommation ou au sein d’une autre entreprise numérique à forte croissance.
Expérience démontrée dans la création ou le développement d’une fonction d’analytique marketing, notamment les tableaux de bord, les cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance, les rapports et les processus de mesure.
Maîtrise avancée de SQL et d’Excel, ainsi qu’une solide expérience avec des outils d’intelligence d’affaires comme Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des outils similaires.
Expérience avec Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok et d’autres plateformes de marketing numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du CAC, de la LTV, du ROAS, du MER, de la rétention, de la conversion, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’attribution et de la rentabilité par client.
Expérience en expérimentation marketing et en mesure de l’incrémentalité, notamment les tests A/B, les tests géographiques et les groupes témoins.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la performance marketing aux résultats commerciaux et financiers de l’entreprise.
Capacité à définir la stratégie analytique tout en explorant personnellement les données et en développant des solutions.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à traduire des données complexes en constats clairs pour les équipes Marketing, Finance et la direction.
Une expérience dans la constitution d’équipes, le mentorat ou la gestion de professionnels en analytique est fortement souhaitée.
Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

Who is Manmade?

We’re a Montreal-based online retailer of premium quality essentials, known particularly so far for our men’s boxer briefs. We have been rapidly growing since launching in 2021, and the brand is truly at a turning point to becoming a household name in Canada, and already growing rapidly in parallel in the US market.

Who is Manmade looking for?

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing Analytics
to build and lead Manmade’s marketing analytics function.

You’ll own how we measure and understand marketing performance, bringing together data across our channels to create a clear, trusted view of what’s driving the business. A key priority will be building a unified source of truth
for marketing performance and establishing the dashboards, KPIs, and measurement frameworks our teams use to make decisions.

This is a senior but deeply hands-on role
. You’ll be expected to dig into the data, build dashboards, analyze performance, and solve problems yourself while creating the foundation for a team and function that can scale with Manmade.

If you love turning complex data into clear business decisions and want the opportunity to build something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Is this for you?

We are growing so rapidly so things are changing so quickly and an in-house presence is required

What are we offering?
Aside from a competitive compensation package, the opportunity in itself is what you make of it. With the company growing 250%+ year over year for the past 3 years, and with expected growth to continue at a high pace for the next 2-3 years, there will be many different ways to grow within the company as it enters new markets, channels, and so on.

We offer extended health and dental benefits, 100% fully paid by the employer. We offer catered lunches every day and all the snacks, drinks, coffee, and fruit you could want.

Responsibilities

Own and build Manmade’s marketing analytics and measurement function across customer acquisition and retention.
Create a unified source of truth for marketing performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, Email, Influencer, Shopify, and web analytics.
Build and maintain dashboards, KPI frameworks, and reporting that give Marketing and leadership a clear view of performance.
Analyze key metrics including CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, customer cohorts, and channel performance.
Partner with Marketing and Finance to connect marketing investment and performance to revenue, customer economics, and profitable growth.
Evaluate channel, campaign, audience, and creative performance and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Develop Manmade’s approach to attribution, incrementality, experimentation, and marketing measurement, including A/B tests, geo studies, and holdouts.
Consolidate and validate data across platforms, ensuring reporting is accurate, reliable, and trusted.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to answer complex business questions and identify opportunities across acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value.
Build scalable analytics processes, tools, and infrastructure, and establish the roadmap for the function as Manmade grows.
Remain deeply hands-on while eventually building and leading a high-performing marketing analytics team.

Qualifications

7–10 years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong experience in e-commerce, DTC, consumer, or another high-growth digital business.
Proven experience building or scaling a marketing analytics function, including dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting, and measurement processes.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel, with strong experience in BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience with Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok, and other digital marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, cohort analysis, attribution, and customer economics.
Experience with marketing experimentation and incrementality, including A/B testing, geo testing, and holdouts.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing performance to broader business and financial outcomes.
Ability to operate at both levels: setting analytics strategy while personally digging into the data and building solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for Marketing, Finance, and leadership.
Experience building, mentoring, or leading analytics talent is strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: VP, Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The VP, Strategy and Operations acts as the Chief Procurement Officer's principal partner in developing and executing strategy and driving the transformation agenda: responsible for developing category strategies to optimise value from third-party spend, building the procurement operating model, and architecting the procurement modernization agenda, focused on technology, AI and process optimisation across source-to-pay. The role demands a strategic, analytical and operational mindset in equal measure, deep functional expertise, a data and technology driven approach, and the ability to lead through influence rather than direct line management.

The role would suit an experienced and/or qualified procurement professional, operating at senior level and requiring deep and broad expertise across procurement strategy, technology and operations. Works independently, sets direction for others and mentors junior members of the team. The role carries no direct category accountability of its own, but rather partners with category and business leaders, and is measured through the results of these teams.

About The Team

RELX leverages its spend through a central Global Procurement function responsible for delivering procurement savings, driving supply chain efficiencies, and mitigating supply risk across all major spend categories — technology, cloud and AI, data and content, marketing, professional services, contingent labour, print and production, facilities and travel. Global Procurement is led by the Chief Procurement Officer, supported by Global Category Leaders and a Programme Management Office responsible for procurement policy, process, tools and operational activity across all spend categories.

About The Role

We are looking for an analytically and intellectually driven senior leader, team player and self-starter with deep operational and strategy expertise across the procurement domain. The role would suit an individual from a technology, finance, consulting or information services background. This role provides significant exposure to and opportunities to influence senior executives across multiple business segments.

The role will be based at a primary RELX location in North America, with periodic international travel to our global offices, and reports to the RELX Chief Procurement Officer.

Main Accountabilities

Own the development and refresh of the Global Procurement multi-year strategy, aligned to RELX Group strategy and to each business area's plan.
Translate strategy into a sequenced transformation roadmap with clear owners, milestones and benefit cases; run the governance that keeps it on track.
Own end-to-end source-to-contract process design and performance, and the technology roadmap.
Drive process simplification, automation and self-service so that policy-compliant buying is the path of least resistance for the business.
Design and evolve the procurement operating model — organisation shape, category architecture, centre-led versus embedded resourcing, location strategy and the interfaces with other business areas.
Partner closely with the PMO to ensure improvement initiatives are executed in alignment with strategy.
Lead and oversee strategic initiatives that cut across categories: supplier consolidation programmes, third-party cost transformation, procurement integration in M&A, and make-versus-buy reviews.
Oversee data management and data quality.
Coach and develop a geographically distributed team of specialists and people managers.
Build senior relationships across business areas and corporate functions.

Requirements

Have substantial senior experience in procurement, sourcing or third-party cost management within a large, complex, multinational organisation, including time in a strategy, operations or transformation role.
Have category expertise across technology and indirect procurement.
Have a proven track record of designing and delivering procurement or functional transformation at scale — operating model change, technology deployment, or process re-engineering.
Have deep working knowledge of the source-to-pay lifecycle and at least one major S2P platform, including implementation or major upgrade experience.
Be strong in commercial and financial fluency — able to build a business case, define and defend savings methodology, and hold a credible conversation with a CFO or divisional finance director.
Be able to influence and earn credibility with executive stakeholders in a federated, multi-business-unit environment where authority is earned rather than granted.
Have experience leading distributed teams, including managing managers, and building capability.
Be an exceptional analytical thinker, comfortable with spend data, taxonomies and analytics tooling.
Be a confident communicator, able to create clear, decision-oriented materials for senior leadership, including Board-level presentations.

This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Director of Finance-CPA Required
jobs.description:
About EVORETRO

EVORETRO is a fast-growing consumer products company expanding across Canada, the U.S., Europe, and international markets.

As we continue to scale our distribution network, product portfolio, inventory, and international operations, we are looking for a hands-on Director of Finance & Strategic Planning
to lead our finance function and help structure the next stage of our growth.

This is not a traditional accounting-only role
.

We are looking for a CPA who wants to be close to the business — someone who can understand the numbers, challenge assumptions, improve profitability, protect cash flow, strengthen financial controls, and help management make better decisions.

Reporting closely to the CEO and working with the leadership team, this person will lead and develop our internal finance team and collaborate with banks, accountants, tax specialists, government partners, and other external advisors.

The Role

As Director of Finance & Strategic Planning, you will be a key financial partner to the CEO and leadership team.

You will lead a finance team of approximately three people across accounting, bookkeeping, controllership, and financial analysis.

Your role will be to bring structure, visibility, discipline, and strong financial judgment to a rapidly growing international business.

You will help management answer important questions such as:

• Where are we generating the strongest margins?
• Where are we losing profitability?
• How much inventory should we purchase?
• How much working capital do we need?
• How do we improve cash flow?
• Where should we invest?
• Which customers, products, countries, and channels are the most profitable?
• What are the financial risks of a new warehouse, 3PL, market, or expansion project?
• How should we structure pricing and customer programs?
• How should we finance continued growth?

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis

• Develop and manage annual budgets, financial forecasts, and long-term financial planning
• Maintain rolling cash-flow forecasts and proactively identify liquidity requirements
• Prepare financial dashboards and management reports for the CEO and leadership team
• Analyze actual performance versus budget and forecast
• Identify financial trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention
• Build financial models to support strategic and operational decisions
• Provide financial analysis and recommendations for leadership and EOS meetings

Profitability & Commercial Finance

• Analyze profitability by product, SKU, customer, channel, country, and project
• Support pricing strategy and margin optimization
• Maintain strong governance around official price lists
• Review discounts, rebates, customer programs, and commercial terms
• Review private-label and special-project quotations
• Support financial analysis for large customer opportunities and distributor programs
• Identify margin leakage, unprofitable activities, and cost-saving opportunities
• Help management improve overall gross margin and operating profitability

Cash Flow & Working Capital

• Monitor and optimize working capital
• Oversee financial analysis related to inventory purchasing and purchasing commitments
• Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable performance
• Help improve inventory turns and reduce excess or slow-moving inventory
• Support purchasing decisions with cash-flow and profitability analysis
• Monitor payment terms, customer credit exposure, and supplier commitments
• Support foreign exchange and cash-management decisions
• Proactively identify future financing requirements

Finance Team Leadership

• Lead, structure, and develop EVORETRO’s internal finance team
• Establish clear responsibilities, accountability, and reporting standards
• Oversee the quality and timeliness of financial reporting
• Strengthen month-end and year-end processes
• Develop stronger financial procedures and internal controls
• Support professional development within the finance team
• Ensure management receives accurate, timely, and decision-useful financial information

Controls, Compliance & Governance

• Establish and improve financial controls, policies, and approval processes
• Strengthen governance around purchasing, pricing, discounts, payments, and major expenditures
• Coordinate Canadian and U.S. tax matters with external tax specialists
• Support analysis related to U.S. sales tax, nexus, and corporate structure
• Work closely with external accountants, auditors, and advisors
• Ensure appropriate financial documentation and compliance processes are maintained
• Support annual financial statements, tax filings, and other reporting requirements
• Identify financial risks and recommend corrective actions

Banking, Financing & External Partners

• Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions
• Support financing activities and credit facility management
• Prepare financial information required by lenders and financial partners
• Support negotiations related to loans, credit facilities, foreign exchange, and other banking services
• Coordinate with accountants, tax specialists, government agencies, and other external advisors
• Identify and evaluate grants, tax credits, and government programs

Strategic Growth & Investment Analysis

• Evaluate the financial impact of new warehouses, 3PLs, and logistics partners
• Analyze international expansion opportunities
• Review major capital investments and strategic projects
• Build ROI and payback analyses
• Support decisions related to new countries, channels, product categories, and business initiatives
• Evaluate the financial implications of growth opportunities before commitments are made
• Support management with capital allocation decisions

Qualifications & Requirements

• CPA designation required

• 7+ years of relevant finance experience
• Previous experience managing or leading a finance/accounting team
• Strong background in FP&A, controllership, commercial finance, or a combination of these areas
• Strong understanding of cash flow, profitability, margins, working capital, and financial controls
• Strong Excel and financial modeling skills
• Strong analytical and business decision-making abilities
• Ability to translate complex financial information into clear business insights and recommendations
• Comfortable working in both a strategic and hands-on capacity
• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate in a fast-growing environment
• Strong communication and leadership skills
• Comfortable challenging assumptions when appropriate
• Experience working closely with senior leadership
• Experience working with banks, accountants, tax specialists, and other external advisors

Experience in the Following Is an Asset

• Distribution
• Wholesale
• Retail
• E-commerce
• Consumer products
• Import/export
• Inventory-intensive businesses
• International operations
• U.S. expansion
• Multi-currency businesses
• Licensed consumer products
• Interest in or experience with the collectibles, trading card, hobby, gaming, or related industries

Who We Are Looking For

• We are looking for someone who combines strong financial fundamentals with commercial judgment.
• You should be comfortable moving from a cash-flow forecast in the morning to a pricing discussion, inventory investment decision, bank meeting, or profitability review later in the day.
• You are someone who wants to understand the business behind the numbers.
• You ask questions.
• You challenge assumptions.
• You identify financial risks before they become problems.
• You help management understand the financial impact of decisions.
• And most importantly, you help build the financial discipline required to support sustainable growth.

Why Join EVORETRO?

At EVORETRO, you won’t simply report the numbers.

You will help shape how the company grows.

This role will have a direct impact on:

• Cash flow
• Profitability
• Pricing
• Inventory investment
• Financial controls
• Financing strategy
• International expansion
• Business performance

You will work closely with the CEO and leadership team and play a meaningful role in strengthening the company’s financial infrastructure as the business continues to scale internationally.

This is an opportunity for a CPA who enjoys being close to operations, commercial decisions, and leadership — while bringing the financial discipline, controls, and strategic insight required by a growing international company.

If you are looking for a hands-on finance leadership role where your expertise can directly influence growth, profitability, cash flow, and major business decisions, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director of Finance And Operations
jobs.description:
Why Join BoomerangFX?

BoomerangFX is redefining how private-pay healthcare practices operate and grow. Recognized through Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 program as one of North America’s fastest-growing technology companies, BFX brings together practice management software, digital marketing, and AI-powered solutions to help healthcare providers build stronger, more profitable businesses.

With offices across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, and India, we are building a global healthcare technology company with an ambitious vision: to become the AI operating system and growth infrastructure for private-pay healthcare.
Our next phase requires financial leadership and operational discipline to turn rapid growth into lasting enterprise value.

As Director of Finance & Operations
, you will work closely with the CEO and leadership team to shape strategic plans, strengthen financial oversight, and improve performance across the business.
This is a hands-on leadership opportunity with meaningful influence over how BFX invests, operates, and scales. We are looking for an accomplished CPA who brings verifiable experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies—and the judgment, ownership, and execution skills to help build our next stage of growth.

Your Role in a Nutshell

You will lead financial oversight, strategic planning, board reporting, and operational performance management across multiple business lines and international markets.
Working closely with the CEO and departmental leaders, you will translate business strategy into budgets, forecasts, operating priorities, and measurable results. You will strengthen cash management, improve profitability, evaluate growth investments, and ensure leadership has accurate information to make timely decisions.
The ideal candidate combines rigorous accounting and financial management skills with commercial judgment and proven operational leadership. You must be comfortable challenging assumptions, holding teams accountable, and moving between strategic analysis and detailed execution.

What You Will Do

Financial Oversight and Control

Oversee accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, and the integrity of financial information across the business.
Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, including financial statements, variance analysis, and management commentary.
Oversee billing, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and payroll controls.
Coordinate external accountants, auditors, and tax advisers to meet reporting and compliance obligations.
Strengthen financial policies, approval processes, and controls as the company scales.

Cash Management and Profitability

Own cash-flow planning, including a rolling 13-week cash forecast and longer-term liquidity projections.
Improve collections, working capital, spending discipline, and visibility into cash commitments.
Analyze profitability by product, service, customer segment, and market.
Identify and execute opportunities to improve gross margins, control operating costs, and increase cash generation.
Evaluate spending and investment proposals against expected returns, payback periods, and business priorities.

Operational Oversight

Partner with departmental leaders to establish operating plans, budgets, KPIs, and clear accountability for results.
Lead regular performance reviews, identifying gaps and ensuring corrective actions have owners and deadlines.
Oversee cross-functional improvement initiatives that strengthen productivity, resource utilization, and execution.
Assess headcount plans, vendor contracts, procurement, and operating expenditures.
Improve workflows, reporting systems, and data quality through automation and appropriate use of AI.
Lead and mentor finance team members while building effective partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Operations.

Strategic Planning and Business Analysis

Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and the financial component of strategic planning.
Develop financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases for hiring, pricing, product investments, partnerships, and international expansion.
Monitor SaaS and recurring-revenue metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, gross margin, customer acquisition costs, and payback.
Translate financial and operational data into clear recommendations on where to invest, improve, defer, or stop.
Balance growth opportunities with disciplined progress toward sustainable profitability.
Support financing, due diligence, acquisitions, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Board and Executive Reporting

Own preparation of board financial packages, executive dashboards, and performance presentations.
Provide clear analysis of financial results, forecasts, cash position, business risks, and recommended actions.
Explain the operational drivers behind performance and highlight material changes against plan.
Ensure board and executive reporting is accurate, consistent, timely, and supported by reliable information.

What We’re Looking For

Mandatory Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing.

At least 10 years of progressive, relevant professional experience following university graduation.

Demonstrated, verifiable experience in high-growth software, SaaS, or technology-enabled companies.
Candidates must be able to substantiate their responsibilities and achievements through specific examples and professional references.
Proven accountability for financial oversight, including accounting, financial statements, internal controls, budgeting, forecasting, and cash management.
Demonstrated operational oversight beyond finance, with experience driving cross-functional performance and execution.
Direct experience in strategic planning, financial modeling, and evaluating business investments.
Hands-on experience preparing board reporting and presenting financial insights to senior executives, boards, or investors.
Strong understanding of recurring-revenue business models and the relationship between growth, retention, margins, and cash.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with accounting, ERP, and financial reporting systems.
Proven ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and hold others accountable for commitments.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to turn complex information into practical business recommendations.

Experience That Will Set You Apart

Helping a growth company achieve break-even or materially improve profitability.
Managing multiple entities, currencies, or international operations.
Experience in healthcare technology or businesses combining software subscriptions and services.
Implementing finance systems, reporting automation, or AI-enabled process improvements.
Supporting capital raises, acquisitions, or transaction readiness.

How You Work

You take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and follow through. You are commercially minded, analytical, and comfortable operating in an environment where priorities evolve quickly. You challenge assumptions constructively and build practical processes that help people make better decisions and deliver results.

What is in it for you:

Location:
Onsite – 5 days per week (Mississauga, Ontario)
Compensation:
$120,000 - $130,000 annual base salary + 25% annual target performance bonus
Total Target Compensation:
CAD $150,000–$162,500 annually.
Performance objectives will reflect measurable outcomes in profitability, cash management, financial reporting, and operational execution.
Equity:
Eligible to participate in BoomerangFX Stock Option Plan after 6 months, subject to plan terms.
Benefits:

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
Paid vacation.
Free on-site parking.
Opportunity to work closely with the CEO and senior leadership on consequential business decisions.
Meaningful responsibility for building the financial and operational foundations of a growing global technology company.
Opportunity to shape how BFX allocates capital, improves performance, and scales internationally.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé with a brief summary of your experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies, including two or three measurable financial or operational results you personally delivered.
Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their experience with financial oversight, operational leadership, strategic planning, and board reporting. CPA credentials, employment experience, and professional references will be verified.

Accessibility Statement

BoomerangFX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to accommodating people with disabilities. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact recruitment@boomerangfx.com.

new_jobs.title: VP, Strategy and Operations
new_jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The VP, Strategy and Operations acts as the Chief Procurement Officer's principal partner in developing and executing strategy and driving the transformation agenda: responsible for developing category strategies to optimise value from third-party spend, building the procurement operating model, and architecting the procurement modernization agenda, focused on technology, AI and process optimisation across source-to-pay. The role demands a strategic, analytical and operational mindset in equal measure, deep functional expertise, a data and technology driven approach, and the ability to lead through influence rather than direct line management.

The role would suit an experienced and/or qualified procurement professional, operating at senior level and requiring deep and broad expertise across procurement strategy, technology and operations. Works independently, sets direction for others and mentors junior members of the team. The role carries no direct category accountability of its own, but rather partners with category and business leaders, and is measured through the results of these teams.

About The Team

RELX leverages its spend through a central Global Procurement function responsible for delivering procurement savings, driving supply chain efficiencies, and mitigating supply risk across all major spend categories — technology, cloud and AI, data and content, marketing, professional services, contingent labour, print and production, facilities and travel. Global Procurement is led by the Chief Procurement Officer, supported by Global Category Leaders and a Programme Management Office responsible for procurement policy, process, tools and operational activity across all spend categories.

About The Role

We are looking for an analytically and intellectually driven senior leader, team player and self-starter with deep operational and strategy expertise across the procurement domain. The role would suit an individual from a technology, finance, consulting or information services background. This role provides significant exposure to and opportunities to influence senior executives across multiple business segments.

The role will be based at a primary RELX location in North America, with periodic international travel to our global offices, and reports to the RELX Chief Procurement Officer.

Main Accountabilities

Own the development and refresh of the Global Procurement multi-year strategy, aligned to RELX Group strategy and to each business area's plan.
Translate strategy into a sequenced transformation roadmap with clear owners, milestones and benefit cases; run the governance that keeps it on track.
Own end-to-end source-to-contract process design and performance, and the technology roadmap.
Drive process simplification, automation and self-service so that policy-compliant buying is the path of least resistance for the business.
Design and evolve the procurement operating model — organisation shape, category architecture, centre-led versus embedded resourcing, location strategy and the interfaces with other business areas.
Partner closely with the PMO to ensure improvement initiatives are executed in alignment with strategy.
Lead and oversee strategic initiatives that cut across categories: supplier consolidation programmes, third-party cost transformation, procurement integration in M&A, and make-versus-buy reviews.
Oversee data management and data quality.
Coach and develop a geographically distributed team of specialists and people managers.
Build senior relationships across business areas and corporate functions.

Requirements

Have substantial senior experience in procurement, sourcing or third-party cost management within a large, complex, multinational organisation, including time in a strategy, operations or transformation role.
Have category expertise across technology and indirect procurement.
Have a proven track record of designing and delivering procurement or functional transformation at scale — operating model change, technology deployment, or process re-engineering.
Have deep working knowledge of the source-to-pay lifecycle and at least one major S2P platform, including implementation or major upgrade experience.
Be strong in commercial and financial fluency — able to build a business case, define and defend savings methodology, and hold a credible conversation with a CFO or divisional finance director.
Be able to influence and earn credibility with executive stakeholders in a federated, multi-business-unit environment where authority is earned rather than granted.
Have experience leading distributed teams, including managing managers, and building capability.
Be an exceptional analytical thinker, comfortable with spend data, taxonomies and analytics tooling.
Be a confident communicator, able to create clear, decision-oriented materials for senior leadership, including Board-level presentations.

This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

• Prepare financial dashboards and management reports for the CEO and leadership team
• Analyze actual performance versus budget and forecast
• Identify financial trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention
• Build financial models to support strategic and operational decisions
• Provide financial analysis and recommendations for leadership and EOS meetings

Profitability & Commercial Finance

• Analyze profitability by product, SKU, customer, channel, country, and project
• Support pricing strategy and margin optimization
• Maintain strong governance around official price lists
• Review discounts, rebates, customer programs, and commercial terms
• Review private-label and special-project quotations
• Support financial analysis for large customer opportunities and distributor programs
• Identify margin leakage, unprofitable activities, and cost-saving opportunities
• Help management improve overall gross margin and operating profitability

Cash Flow & Working Capital

• Monitor and optimize working capital
• Oversee financial analysis related to inventory purchasing and purchasing commitments
• Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable performance
• Help improve inventory turns and reduce excess or slow-moving inventory
• Support purchasing decisions with cash-flow and profitability analysis
• Monitor payment terms, customer credit exposure, and supplier commitments
• Support foreign exchange and cash-management decisions
• Proactively identify future financing requirements

Finance Team Leadership

• Lead, structure, and develop EVORETRO’s internal finance team
• Establish clear responsibilities, accountability, and reporting standards
• Oversee the quality and timeliness of financial reporting
• Strengthen month-end and year-end processes
• Develop stronger financial procedures and internal controls
• Support professional development within the finance team
• Ensure management receives accurate, timely, and decision-useful financial information

Controls, Compliance & Governance

• Establish and improve financial controls, policies, and approval processes
• Strengthen governance around purchasing, pricing, discounts, payments, and major expenditures
• Coordinate Canadian and U.S. tax matters with external tax specialists
• Support analysis related to U.S. sales tax, nexus, and corporate structure
• Work closely with external accountants, auditors, and advisors
• Ensure appropriate financial documentation and compliance processes are maintained
• Support annual financial statements, tax filings, and other reporting requirements
• Identify financial risks and recommend corrective actions

Banking, Financing & External Partners

• Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions
• Support financing activities and credit facility management
• Prepare financial information required by lenders and financial partners
• Support negotiations related to loans, credit facilities, foreign exchange, and other banking services
• Coordinate with accountants, tax specialists, government agencies, and other external advisors
• Identify and evaluate grants, tax credits, and government programs

Strategic Growth & Investment Analysis

• Evaluate the financial impact of new warehouses, 3PLs, and logistics partners
• Analyze international expansion opportunities
• Review major capital investments and strategic projects
• Build ROI and payback analyses
• Support decisions related to new countries, channels, product categories, and business initiatives
• Evaluate the financial implications of growth opportunities before commitments are made
• Support management with capital allocation decisions

Qualifications & Requirements

• CPA designation required

• 7+ years of relevant finance experience
• Previous experience managing or leading a finance/accounting team
• Strong background in FP&A, controllership, commercial finance, or a combination of these areas
• Strong understanding of cash flow, profitability, margins, working capital, and financial controls
• Strong Excel and financial modeling skills
• Strong analytical and business decision-making abilities
• Ability to translate complex financial information into clear business insights and recommendations
• Comfortable working in both a strategic and hands-on capacity
• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate in a fast-growing environment
• Strong communication and leadership skills
• Comfortable challenging assumptions when appropriate
• Experience working closely with senior leadership
• Experience working with banks, accountants, tax specialists, and other external advisors

Experience in the Following Is an Asset

• Distribution
• Wholesale
• Retail
• E-commerce
• Consumer products
• Import/export
• Inventory-intensive businesses
• International operations
• U.S. expansion
• Multi-currency businesses
• Licensed consumer products
• Interest in or experience with the collectibles, trading card, hobby, gaming, or related industries

Who We Are Looking For

• We are looking for someone who combines strong financial fundamentals with commercial judgment.
• You should be comfortable moving from a cash-flow forecast in the morning to a pricing discussion, inventory investment decision, bank meeting, or profitability review later in the day.
• You are someone who wants to understand the business behind the numbers.
• You ask questions.
• You challenge assumptions.
• You identify financial risks before they become problems.
• You help management understand the financial impact of decisions.
• And most importantly, you help build the financial discipline required to support sustainable growth.

Why Join EVORETRO?

At EVORETRO, you won’t simply report the numbers.

You will help shape how the company grows.

This role will have a direct impact on:

• Cash flow
• Profitability
• Pricing
• Inventory investment
• Financial controls
• Financing strategy
• International expansion
• Business performance

You will work closely with the CEO and leadership team and play a meaningful role in strengthening the company’s financial infrastructure as the business continues to scale internationally.

This is an opportunity for a CPA who enjoys being close to operations, commercial decisions, and leadership — while bringing the financial discipline, controls, and strategic insight required by a growing international company.

If you are looking for a hands-on finance leadership role where your expertise can directly influence growth, profitability, cash flow, and major business decisions, we’d like to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Director of Finance And Operations
new_jobs.description:
Why Join BoomerangFX?

BoomerangFX is redefining how private-pay healthcare practices operate and grow. Recognized through Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 program as one of North America’s fastest-growing technology companies, BFX brings together practice management software, digital marketing, and AI-powered solutions to help healthcare providers build stronger, more profitable businesses.

With offices across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, and India, we are building a global healthcare technology company with an ambitious vision: to become the AI operating system and growth infrastructure for private-pay healthcare.
Our next phase requires financial leadership and operational discipline to turn rapid growth into lasting enterprise value.

As Director of Finance & Operations
, you will work closely with the CEO and leadership team to shape strategic plans, strengthen financial oversight, and improve performance across the business.
This is a hands-on leadership opportunity with meaningful influence over how BFX invests, operates, and scales. We are looking for an accomplished CPA who brings verifiable experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies—and the judgment, ownership, and execution skills to help build our next stage of growth.

Your Role in a Nutshell

You will lead financial oversight, strategic planning, board reporting, and operational performance management across multiple business lines and international markets.
Working closely with the CEO and departmental leaders, you will translate business strategy into budgets, forecasts, operating priorities, and measurable results. You will strengthen cash management, improve profitability, evaluate growth investments, and ensure leadership has accurate information to make timely decisions.
The ideal candidate combines rigorous accounting and financial management skills with commercial judgment and proven operational leadership. You must be comfortable challenging assumptions, holding teams accountable, and moving between strategic analysis and detailed execution.

What You Will Do

Financial Oversight and Control

Oversee accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, and the integrity of financial information across the business.
Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, including financial statements, variance analysis, and management commentary.
Oversee billing, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and payroll controls.
Coordinate external accountants, auditors, and tax advisers to meet reporting and compliance obligations.
Strengthen financial policies, approval processes, and controls as the company scales.

Cash Management and Profitability

Own cash-flow planning, including a rolling 13-week cash forecast and longer-term liquidity projections.
Improve collections, working capital, spending discipline, and visibility into cash commitments.
Analyze profitability by product, service, customer segment, and market.
Identify and execute opportunities to improve gross margins, control operating costs, and increase cash generation.
Evaluate spending and investment proposals against expected returns, payback periods, and business priorities.

Operational Oversight

Partner with departmental leaders to establish operating plans, budgets, KPIs, and clear accountability for results.
Lead regular performance reviews, identifying gaps and ensuring corrective actions have owners and deadlines.
Oversee cross-functional improvement initiatives that strengthen productivity, resource utilization, and execution.
Assess headcount plans, vendor contracts, procurement, and operating expenditures.
Improve workflows, reporting systems, and data quality through automation and appropriate use of AI.
Lead and mentor finance team members while building effective partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Operations.

Strategic Planning and Business Analysis

Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and the financial component of strategic planning.
Develop financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases for hiring, pricing, product investments, partnerships, and international expansion.
Monitor SaaS and recurring-revenue metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, gross margin, customer acquisition costs, and payback.
Translate financial and operational data into clear recommendations on where to invest, improve, defer, or stop.
Balance growth opportunities with disciplined progress toward sustainable profitability.
Support financing, due diligence, acquisitions, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Board and Executive Reporting

Own preparation of board financial packages, executive dashboards, and performance presentations.
Provide clear analysis of financial results, forecasts, cash position, business risks, and recommended actions.
Explain the operational drivers behind performance and highlight material changes against plan.
Ensure board and executive reporting is accurate, consistent, timely, and supported by reliable information.

What We’re Looking For

Mandatory Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing.

At least 10 years of progressive, relevant professional experience following university graduation.

Demonstrated, verifiable experience in high-growth software, SaaS, or technology-enabled companies.
Candidates must be able to substantiate their responsibilities and achievements through specific examples and professional references.
Proven accountability for financial oversight, including accounting, financial statements, internal controls, budgeting, forecasting, and cash management.
Demonstrated operational oversight beyond finance, with experience driving cross-functional performance and execution.
Direct experience in strategic planning, financial modeling, and evaluating business investments.
Hands-on experience preparing board reporting and presenting financial insights to senior executives, boards, or investors.
Strong understanding of recurring-revenue business models and the relationship between growth, retention, margins, and cash.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with accounting, ERP, and financial reporting systems.
Proven ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and hold others accountable for commitments.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to turn complex information into practical business recommendations.

Experience That Will Set You Apart

Helping a growth company achieve break-even or materially improve profitability.
Managing multiple entities, currencies, or international operations.
Experience in healthcare technology or businesses combining software subscriptions and services.
Implementing finance systems, reporting automation, or AI-enabled process improvements.
Supporting capital raises, acquisitions, or transaction readiness.

How You Work

You take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and follow through. You are commercially minded, analytical, and comfortable operating in an environment where priorities evolve quickly. You challenge assumptions constructively and build practical processes that help people make better decisions and deliver results.

What is in it for you:

Location:
Onsite – 5 days per week (Mississauga, Ontario)
Compensation:
$120,000 - $130,000 annual base salary + 25% annual target performance bonus
Total Target Compensation:
CAD $150,000–$162,500 annually.
Performance objectives will reflect measurable outcomes in profitability, cash management, financial reporting, and operational execution.
Equity:
Eligible to participate in BoomerangFX Stock Option Plan after 6 months, subject to plan terms.
Benefits:

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
Paid vacation.
Free on-site parking.
Opportunity to work closely with the CEO and senior leadership on consequential business decisions.
Meaningful responsibility for building the financial and operational foundations of a growing global technology company.
Opportunity to shape how BFX allocates capital, improves performance, and scales internationally.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé with a brief summary of your experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies, including two or three measurable financial or operational results you personally delivered.
Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their experience with financial oversight, operational leadership, strategic planning, and board reporting. CPA credentials, employment experience, and professional references will be verified.

Accessibility Statement

BoomerangFX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to accommodating people with disabilities. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact recruitment@boomerangfx.com.
